evaluation_components.notes: Partially Closed and Partially Open Bookα

attendance_policy: A total of THREE quizzes (each of 10 marks) will be conducted under continuous evaluation. Best TWO will be considered for final evaluation (i.e., ONE buffer). This Type-II quiz marks (10%) will be considered for final grading only if the student maintains a minimum of 50% attendance. This requirement applies to students with ID numbers 2024B2XXXX and 2025B2XXXX.
makeup_policy: Make-up will be considered for genuine cases as per the Institute rules against an application by the student with proper documents. See Part I for details.
